title: DANGEROUS MORNING PRAYERS THAT WORK
text: I want you to do me a favor right now. Share this prayer point with everyone in your contact list. Don't keep it to yourself. There are people on your timeline, in your WhatsApp groups, in your family circles, who are under serious spiritual siege, and they don't even know that the breakthrough they've been crying for is wrapped in the prophetic utterances we're about to release this morning. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes chapter 4 that two are better than one and a three-fold cord is not quickly broken. When you share this, you're not just forwarding a message. You're becoming a carrier of prophetic fire that will set captives free. So, pause for a moment, share this now, and let's proceed into the deep things of the spirit. Now, I need you to understand something very fundamental about the morning hour. The morning is not just another time of the day. It is a prophetic gateway. It is the womb from which the rest of your day is birthed. What you permit in the morning, what you decree in the morning, what you establish in the morning will determine the trajectory of your entire day. The enemy knows this, which is [music] why he fights violently to keep believers asleep, distracted, prayerless, and spiritually dormant in the morning hours. But you are not ordinary. You are a royal priesthood, a chosen generation, a peculiar people called out of darkness into his marvelous light. The scripture says in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Did you see that? In the morning I will direct my prayer. Direction implies intentionality. It means you are not praying anyhow. You're not just saying words. You are aiming your prayers like arrows. You are positioning your spirit like a warrior on the battlefield. You are taking your stand in the realm of the spirit before the enemy even knows what hit him. This is what separates the ordinary believer from the dangerous believer. This is what distinguishes those who are always crying and complaining from those who are always conquering and possessing their possessions. I prophesy over your life right now. Every satanic arrangement that has been programmed to frustrate your day, I command it to scatter by fire in the name of Jesus. Every monitoring spirit that has been assigned to track your movements, to report your progress to the kingdom of darkness, I command that spirit to be struck with blindness right now in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. You will not be a victim today. You will not be a casualty today. You will not be a statistic today. You are coming out of this prayer as a victor, as a champion, as one who has been divinely fortified for unprecedented success. Now listen carefully. There are three dimensions of morning prayers that every believer must understand. The first dimension is the prayer of consecration. This is where you set yourself apart unto God. You don't just jump into spiritual warfare without first aligning yourself with the purposes of heaven. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:23 that his mercies are new every morning and great is his faithfulness. Every morning is a fresh opportunity for mercy, for grace, for divine repositioning. So before you start commanding and decreeing, you must first [music] present yourself as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable unto God. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before your throne of grace this morning. I thank you for the gift of life. I thank you for your faithfulness that has kept me through the night. I thank you that I did not die in my sleep. That I [music] was not consumed by the plans of the enemy. That I have woken up to see a new day filled with divine possibilities. Lord, I consecrate myself aresh to you this morning. Let every area of my [music] life that has been contaminated by sin, by compromise, by spiritual laziness be cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost purge me from the inside out. I decree that I'm a vessel unto honor, sanctified and made for the master's use, prepared unto every good work. The second dimension is the prayer of protection. You see, the moment you wake up, you have entered into a battlefield. The Bible describes our adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion walking about seeking whom he may devour. He's not seeking whom he will devour. He's seeking whom he may devour. That word may implies that he cannot just devour anybody. He can only devour those who are not covered, those who are not prayed up, those who are not fortified in the spirit. But when you pray dangerous morning prayers, you are erecting a wall of fire around yourself, around your family, around your destiny, and the enemy cannot penetrate that wall. In the name of Jesus Christ, I cover myself today with the blood of Jesus. Every arrow of the wicked fashion against my life, I command it to backfire now in the name of Jesus. Every evil pot that is boiling with my name, with my picture, with my identity, I command that pot to crack and scatter by fire in the mighty name of Jesus. Every satanic priest that has been assigned to my case, every witchcraft coven that has been monitoring my progress, I command confusion into their ranks right now, let them scatter themselves. Let them fight among themselves. Let them destroy their own evil works in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. I decree and declare that no weapon formed against me today shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn it now according to Isaiah 54:17. I am untouchable. I am unmovable. I am unreachable by the forces of darkness. I walk in divine immunity. I operate under heavenly insurance. The angels of the Lord are that encamped around me, before me, behind me, on my left hand and on my right hand. Any demon that attempts to attack me today will have to contend with the armies of heaven. And we know how that always ends with the total defeat and humiliation of the kingdom [music] of darkness. The third dimension is the prayer of declaration and decree. This is where you begin to prophesy into your day. You see, God has given us the authority to frame our world with the words of our mouth. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." You are eating the fruit of what you have been saying. If your life is full of tragedy, full of setbacks, full of disappointments, I want you to check what you've been speaking. Have you been speaking fear? Have you been speaking doubt? Have you been speaking defeat? then that's exactly what you're going to harvest. But this morning, we're going to speak differently. We're going to decree the word of the Lord over our lives, over our families, over our businesses, over our careers, over our ministries. We're going to prophesy success. We're going to prophesy breakthrough. We're going to prophesy divine favor. We're going to prophesy open doors. And when we speak, heaven will respond because we are not speaking from our own imagination. We are speaking the written word of God and his word does not return unto him void. I decree and declare that this is my day of divine favor. This is my day of supernatural breakthrough. This is my day of uncommon acceleration. Everything that was delayed in my life receive speed now in the name of Jesus. Everything that was denied me, I [music] recover it now by fire. Everything that was stolen from me, I take it back now by the authority in the name of Jesus Christ. I am a candidate for miracles today. I am a candidate for signs and wonders today. I am a candidate for testimonies that will make people question what kind of God I serve. Let me tell you something that many believers don't understand. The morning prayer is not just about you. It's about positioning yourself to be a blessing channel for others. When you pray dangerous morning prayers, you're not just securing your own victory. You're opening doors for divine appointments that God has scheduled for you. You're aligning yourself with people you're supposed to meet, with opportunities you're supposed to access, with information you're supposed to receive. The Bible says in Psalm 118:4, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." Every day that God makes comes with divine packages. But you need spiritual sensitivity to locate those [music] packages. And that sensitivity comes through prayer. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree that every divine appointment that you have scheduled for me today, I will not miss it. Every door that you have ordained to open for me today, it will open at the appointed time. Every person that I'm supposed to meet today who will be a blessing to my life, orchestrate that meeting by your divine providence. Let there be no delay. Let there be no deviation. Let there be no distraction. I am walking in perfect alignment with your will for my life today and I will fulfill every divine assignment that you have written in your book concerning me. Now I want to address something very critical. There are morning prayers and then there are dangerous morning prayers. What makes a prayer dangerous is not the volume of your voice. It's the level of your spiritual violence. The Bible says in Matthew 11:12 that from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. That word violent is not talking about physical aggression. It's talking about spiritual militancy. It's talking about holy desperation. is talking about righteous aggression in the place of prayer. When you pray dangerous prayers, you're not begging God. You're enforcing the finished work of Calvary. You're not asking the devil for permission. You're commanding him to release what belongs to you. You're not negotiating with circumstances. You're prophesying change into dead situations. This is the kind of prayer that moves mountains. This is the kind of prayer that opens blind eyes. This is the kind of prayer that raises the dead. This is the kind of prayer that breaks generational curses and establishes generational blessings. I speak to every generational curse operating in your bloodline right now. Every cause of poverty, every cause of failure, every cause of sickness, every cause of premature death, every cause of marital turbulence, every cause of mental disorder. I break it now by the power in the blood of Jesus. I decree that you are the cause breaker in your family. You are the covenant restorer in your generation. You are the glory carrier that will change the story of your lineage. From this day forward, your family will no longer be known for tragedy. They will be known for testimony. They will no longer be known for failure. They will be known for success. They will no longer be known for sickness. They will be known for divine health and supernatural longevity. Listen to me very carefully. The enemy fights the morning hour because he knows that whoever controls the morning controls the day. And whoever controls the day controls the week and whoever controls the week controls the month and whoever controls the month controls the year and whoever controls the year controls their destiny. This is why you cannot afford to be casual about your morning devotion. This is why you cannot afford to sleep through the prayer hour. This is why you cannot afford to replace prayer with social media, with television, with unnecessary conversations. The first thing your spirit must connect with in the morning is not your phone, it's your God. The Bible says in Mark 1:35, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." This was Jesus, the son of God, the one who had all power in heaven and on earth. Yet he understood the importance of [music] the morning prayer. If Jesus needed to pray early in the morning, how much more do we need to pray? If Jesus needed to seek the face of his father before engaging with the day, how much more [music] do we need divine direction before we step into the arena of life? Father, I thank you for the revelation of the morning hour. I repent for every time I have been lazy in prayer. I repent for every time I have prioritized other things above, seeking your face. I repent for every time I have allowed the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, and the lust for other things to choke your word in my life. From this day forward, I commit myself to the discipline of dangerous morning prayers. Let the fire of intercession burn in my spirit. Let the hunger for your presence consume my heart. Let the passion for spiritual warfare dominate my life. Now, there are specific things that dangerous morning prayers must address. Number one, you must pray against every satanic agenda for your day. The kingdom of darkness does not sleep. They hold meetings. They strategize. They plan. They deploy forces. Before you woke up this morning, the enemy had already scheduled attacks, arranged disappointments, positioned distractions, and activated delays. But when you pray, you are interrupting those evil schedules. You are scattering those demonic consultations. You are aborting those wicked plans before they even materialize. Every satanic agenda for my life today, I [music] scatter it now by fire. Every evil meeting that was held concerning me last [music] night, I nullify the decisions of that meeting in the name of Jesus. Every demon that was assigned to frustrate me today, I command you to go back to your sender. Every witchcraft manipulation that was programmed to trigger confusion in my mind, I reject it now. I command mental clarity. I command spiritual alertness. I command supernatural wisdom to navigate every situation I will encounter today. I will not make mistakes today. I will not fall into traps today. I will not be deceived today. The spirit of the Lord is my guide and he leads me in the path of righteousness for his [music] name's sake. Number two, you must pray for divine acceleration. We are living in times where things are moving very fast. Technology is advancing. Society is changing. Economies are shifting. If you don't have divine speed, you will be left behind. But I prophesy to somebody reading this now, God is about to accelerate you in a way that will shock your enemies and surprise your friends. Things that were supposed to take you 10 years, God will accomplish them in 10 months. Things that were supposed to take you 10 months, God will accomplish them in 10 weeks. This is your season of supernatural speed. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I decree divine acceleration over my life. Everything that has been moving slowly receive speed now. My business receive acceleration. My career receive acceleration. My ministry receive acceleration. My academic pursuits receive acceleration. My marital settlement receive acceleration. Every area of my life that the enemy has put in slow motion, I command it to enter into fast forward now by the power of the Holy Ghost. I am coming out of delay. I am coming out of stagnation. I am coming out of frustration. I am entering into my season of speed, my season of promotion, my season of elevation, my season of manifestation. Number three, you must pray for divine favor. Favor is the secret weapon of champions. Favor is what opens doors that your qualifications cannot open. Favor is what gives you access [music] to places where your credentials cannot take you. Favor is what makes people help you without you begging them. Favor is what makes opportunities locate you instead of you searching for opportunities. And the beautiful thing about favor is that it's not based on your merit. It's based [music] on God's mercy. Lord, I ask for uncommon favor today. Let me find favor in the sight of God and man. Every person I will meet today, let them be favorably disposed toward me. Every organization I will interact with today, let them treat me with unusual preferential treatment. Let doors open for me that are close to others. Let opportunities come to me that are denied to others. Let resources flow to me from unexpected sources. I am a carrier of divine favor. I am a magnet for heavenly blessings. Goodness and mercy are following me all the days of my life and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Number four, you must pray for spiritual sensitivity. In these last days, discernment is not optional. It is essential. The Bible warns us that in the last days, there will be false prophets, false teachers, false miracles, and false doctrines. Many will be deceived because they lack spiritual discernment. But you are not going to be part of the statistics of the deceived. God is going to give you eyes to see what others cannot see and ears to hear what others cannot hear. Father, open my spiritual eyes and ears today. Let me perceive the spiritual climate around me. Let me discern the spirits that are operating in every environment I enter. Give me the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Christ. Let me know when to speak and when to keep quiet. Let me know when to move and when to stay. Let me know when to engage and when to withdraw. I decree that I will not be deceived by appearances. I will not be fooled by smooth words. [music] I will not be manipulated by emotional tactics. The Holy Spirit is my teacher and he guides me into all truth. Number five, you must pray for financial breakthrough. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18 that it is God who gives us power to get wealth. Money is not evil. The love of money is the root of all evil. God wants you to prosper. God wants you to have more than enough. God wants you to be a blessing to others. But the enemy fights your finances because he knows that when you have financial resources, you can do more for the kingdom of God. Every spirit of poverty operating in my life, I bind you now and cast you out in the name of Jesus. Every demon of lack, every demon of insufficiency, every demon of financial struggle, I command you to release me now. I am not a beggar. I am not a borrower. I am a lender unto many nations. The blessing of Abraham is mine through Christ Jesus. I decree that my hands are blessed. My business is blessed. My investments are blessed. My career is blessed. Money is coming to me from the north, from the south, from the east, and from the west. I am a money magnet for kingdom purposes. Wealth and riches are in my house, and my righteousness endures forever. Let me pause here and tell you something that will revolutionize your prayer life. Most believers pray from a position of defeat, begging God to give them victory. But the scripture says in 1 Corinthians 15:57, "But thanks be to God which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ." Notice that verb tense. It doesn't say God will give us victory in the future. It says God gives us victory present tense. The victory is already yours. Jesus already defeated the devil at Calvary. He already disarmed principalities and powers and made a public spectacle of them. So when you pray, you are not asking God to defeat the enemy. You are enforcing the defeat that has already been accomplished. This changes everything. This means you don't pray from weakness, you pray from strength. You don't pray from poverty, you pray from abundance. You don't pray from sickness, you pray from health. You don't pray from bondage, you pray from freedom. You are seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principality, power, might and dominion. You are praying from the throne, [music] not to the throne. You are praying from victory, not for victory. I decree and declare that I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and [music] not beneath. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. No curse can locate me. No evil can touch me. No weapon formed against me can prosper. I am untouchable by the forces of darkness. I am unreachable by the powers of hell. I am undefeitable by the strategies of Satan. I have been made victorious by the blood of the lamb and by the word of my testimony. Now let's address some specific areas [music] that require dangerous morning prayers. First your mind. The battlefield of life is in the mind. The Bible says in Romans 12:2, "Be not conformed to this world, but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind." The enemy knows that if he can control your thoughts, he can control your life. This is why he bombards your mind with negative thoughts, fearful imaginations, evil suggestions, and demonic impressions. But you have the power to cast down every imagination and bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. Every negative thought pattern in my mind, I break it now by fire. Every spirit of fear, I cast you out in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of depression, I reject you. Every spirit of anxiety, I refuse you. Every spirit of confusion, I bind you and render you powerless over my life. I decree that my mind is the temple of the Holy Ghost. My thoughts are pure. My imaginations are sanctified. I think on things that are true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report. I have the mind of Christ. And I am mentally fortified for victory. Second, your family. The enemy attacks families because he knows that the family is the foundation of society. If he can destroy families, he can destroy nations. But your family will not be a casualty. Your family will not be a victim. Your family will be a testimony of God's preserving grace and protecting power. I cover my entire family with the blood of Jesus. My spouse, my children, my parents, my siblings, I decree divine protection over their lives. Every evil eye that is looking at my family with envy and jealousy be blinded now in the name of Jesus. Every evil mouth that is speaking curses against my family be silenced forever. Every witchcraft attack against my household backfire by fire. I decree that my home is established on the rock of Jesus Christ and the gates of hell cannot prevail against it. Peace reigns in my home. Love abounds in my home. The glory of God fills my home. Third, your workplace or business. This is where many believers face their greatest battles in the marketplace. You're dealing with office politics, jealous colleagues, wicked supervisors, fraudulent partners, and difficult clients. But you're not alone in that environment. The Holy Spirit is with you. The angels of God are with you. And when you pray dangerous morning prayers, you're activating supernatural intervention in your workplace. Father, I ask for divine intervention in my workplace today. Every envious colleague, let them be put to shame. Every wicked supervisor, let your power humble them. Every plan to frustrate me or sabotage my efforts, let it fail woefully. I decree that I am favored in my workplace. [music] I am celebrated in my workplace. I am promoted in my workplace. I am indispensable in my workplace. My value is recognized. My contributions are acknowledged. My efforts are rewarded. I am climbing the ladder of success and no man can stop my ascension. Fourth, your health. The Bible says in 3 John verse 2, beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth. God's will for you is divine health. Sickness is not from God is from the devil. Jesus went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed of the devil because [music] God was with him. And the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead dwells in you and quickens your mortal body. Every sickness in my body be healed now in the name of Jesus. Every disease, every infirmity, every pain, every discomfort, I command you to leave my body now. I am healed by the stripes of Jesus. I am whole by the power of God. I decree divine health over my body. My immune system is strengthened. My organs are functioning perfectly. My blood is pure. My bones are strong. I am walking in supernatural health and vitality. I will live long and finish strong. I will fulfill my days on earth and see my children's children. Let me tell you something powerful. When you pray dangerous morning prayers consistently, you're not just addressing immediate needs. You're building spiritual momentum every morning that you show up in prayer. You're making deposits in the spirit realm. You're accumulating spiritual capital. You're stacking up prayers that will answer themselves in the future. This is why Daniel prayed three times a day. This is why David said he would pray evening, morning, and noon. This is why Paul said we should pray without ceasing. They understood the principle of spiritual accumulation. Some of you are frustrated because you prayed once, twice, three times and you didn't see results. But I'm telling you, don't give up. Keep praying. Keep declaring. Keep decreeing. Your prayers are not falling on deaf ears. Heaven is keeping records. Angels are taking notes. God is preparing your answer. And one day, suddenly, everything you've been praying for will manifest at once. And people wonder what happened. What happened is that your prayers have accumulated enough spiritual weight to break through every barrier and bring forth your miracle. I decree and declare that this is your season of answered prayers. Every prayer you've ever prayed that seems like it was not answered, I command it to receive divine attention now. Every promise that God spoke to you that seems delayed, I prophesy acceleration upon that promise. Every vision that he showed you that seems like he's dying, I command resurrection life into that vision. God is not a man that he should lie, neither the son of man that he should repent. What he has promised, he is faithful to perform. Now, as we begin to wrap up this powerful prayer session, I want you to pray with me one more dangerous prayer. This is a prayer of total surrender and absolute faith. This is where you release everything into the hands of God and trust him completely for the outcome. Father, I surrender my life to you aresh this morning. I surrender my plans, my desires, my ambitions, my goals, everything. Take control of my life and lead me in the path you have ordained for me. I trust you completely. I believe in you absolutely. I know that you are working all things together for my good because I love you and I am called according to your purpose. I may not understand everything that's happening in my life right now, but I know that you are in control and that's enough for me. Lead me, guide me, protect me, provide for me, and use me for your glory. I receive the anointing for dominion today. I receive the grace for unprecedented favor today. I receive the power for supernatural breakthrough today. I receive the wisdom for uncommon success. Today I receive the blessing for generational transformation today. From this morning forward, my life is taking a new direction. My story is taking a new turn. My destiny is entering a new dimension. I am moving from glory to glory. From faith to faith, from strength to strength, from victory to victory. Every mountain standing before me, be removed now and be cast into the sea. Every obstacle blocking my path, be cleared now by [music] divine intervention. Every red sea situation in my life, I command you to part now in the name of Jesus. [music] Every Jericho wall surrounding my breakthrough, fall down flat now by the power of God. Every golad mocking my destiny, receive your stone today and fall down dead. I am an overcomer. I am a world changer. I am a history maker. I am a kingdom influencer. Now, as you step out of this prayer into your day, I want you to remember that you are not ordinary. [music] You are a child of the most high God. You carry his DNA. You bear his image. You represent his kingdom. Walk with authority today. Talk with confidence today. Move with boldness today. The lion of the tribe of Judah lives inside you. So [music] walk like a lion, not like a sheep. You're not prey. You're a predator in [music] the spirit realm. The enemy should be afraid of you, not you being afraid of him. I decree that this day [music] belongs to you. This week belongs to you. This month belongs to you. This year belongs to you. Everything the enemy has stolen from you in the past, you're recovering it all today by fire. Every lost opportunity, come back now. Every stolen blessing return now. Every delayed miracle manifest now. Every denied promotion [music] locate me now. I am a candidate for divine restoration. And what God is giving me back will be greater than what was taken from me. Go forth today in the power of the Holy Ghost. Go forth in the name of Jesus Christ. Go forth in the authority of the word of God. And remember, you are victorious. You are blessed. You are favored. You are protected. You are provided for. And you are loved by the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords. This is your day of triumph. This is your day of breakthrough. This is your day of manifestation. Walking it, living it, celebrating it in Jesus mighty name. Amen.
